analysis:
Only base_text for docs/provider/cli-reference.md was supplied, in two units (lines 1-417 and 418-919). No patch or head text was included, so the actual PR delta is not visible. Coverage is limited to the base text, and no regression can be claimed or cleared. The file is documentation-only (mode 100644 on both sides).

The base text describes these security-relevant behaviors, which a later pass should compare against the head:
- enroll/unenroll: on macOS 27+ App Attest is guidance only and is not a serving grant. New identities need qualified App Attest, and the legacy profile flow is limited to the frozen cohort, with POST /v1/enroll proof (TB-009, TB-011, T-052, T-057).
- The macOS<27 upgrade warning performs no network, config or profile operations.
- The restart/startup-timeout text says "self_route" owner authorization is not public-fleet eligibility (TB-002).
- Autopilot: shadow mode is not activated, consent is not authorization, and inventory is an exact-build allowlist.
- switch/models_replace: the ack/resumed receipt flow fails closed.
- stop/restart drain semantics and --force are described.
- status/doctor expose daemon state and App Attest diagnostics, which are untrusted metadata (TB-002, T-058).

A head diff that weakened these statements would be a threat-model documentation gap. Examples would be implying that enroll or the OS choice grants serving, that a profile can be copied for new identities, or that diagnostics are trust evidence. No such change is observable here, so no findings are reported.
